##### Project general facts

Stamn Nautis Residences is an ocean-inspired luxury development in one of Dubai's most ambitious waterfront projects. The project takes the ocean as its design inspiration, blending modern design with natural elements and featuring unique wave-shaped balconies that endow the architecture with aesthetic appeal. Offering a diverse range of layouts from versatile one-bedroom units to spacious luxury four-bedroom residences, each home is designed to cater to differentiated living needs, enabling architecture and nature to coexist in harmony.

Residents enjoy a wealth of amenities designed to enhance every aspect of life. The development features a fully equipped gym, an outdoor leisure reading area, BBQ and private dining spaces, and family gathering areas with interactive playgrounds and open-air picnic pavilions. The 21-kilometer golden coastline weaves a poetic dialogue between life and nature, immersing every moment in the gentle embrace of sea breeze and warm sunshine. World-class shopping, gourmet dining, luxury boutiques, vibrant markets, and exclusive yachting access further enrich the lifestyle.

Every residence at Stamn Nautis features scientifically planned area ratios with interiors following active-quiet zoning logic. The living room and dining area are connected in a fully lit and transparent layout, complemented by panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows. Bedrooms adopt a fully lit design with large daylighting areas inviting warm sunlight, turning every waking moment into a poetic encounter that dances with nature. The design integrates vision, touch, and hearing to create a residence that fuses sensory experiences, offering broad prospects and substantial returns for discerning investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled at the mouth of Dubai Creek, Dubai Islands is a groundbreaking development by Nakheel, the masterminds behind Palm Jumeirah. Spanning across five interconnected islands, it stands as Dubai's largest waterfront project, blending natural beauty with urban innovation. Offering pristine beaches, marinas, and direct Persian Gulf access, the development creates a coastal lifestyle unmatched in the region.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and proximity to key destinations. Infinity Bridge, Waterfront Market, Dubai International Airport, La Mer Beach, Jumeirah Public Beach, Dubai Frame, Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai, and Dubai Mall are all within easy reach. The 21-kilometer golden coastline weaves a poetic dialogue between life and nature, while world-class shopping, dining, and exclusive yachting access create a lifestyle of unparalleled sophistication.

For those seeking a residence that embodies ocean-inspired elegance, coastal living, and a prime Dubai address, Dubai Islands delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where every return voyage and departure becomes the ultimate tribute to life — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
